description: Genre-aware default resolvers. Each preset provides a merge tree of default values keyed by dot-paths into film-dsl-v2.1. Resolution rule: genre_lock.cinematography_preset_ref → lookup here → deep-merge into workflow defaults → then apply genre_lock.preset_override (which replaces, not merges).

performance_lock_defaults.breath_rule: breath is a visible physical event: white plume in cold, subtle chest rise otherwise — never decorative
performance_lock_defaults.breakdown_rule: the moment of internal break is externalized as a slow-lowered sleeve, a released grip on a hilt, or a single blink that lasts one extra frame — never as a facial contortion
performance_lock_defaults.hand_task_rule: hands are almost always engaged with an object (sword hilt, teacup, brush, sleeve fold); rest position is not empty — it holds a formal placement (礼)
performance_lock_defaults.gaze_rule: gaze lands on the object of contemplation for one full second before moving to the person — objects are read before people
transfer_rules_when_impossible: sleeve movement replaces hand gesture when hand is occupied
shoulder set replaces head turn when speaker is off-camera
breath plume replaces facial tell in low-light

style_lock_defaults.lighting_base_ancient: candlelight warm gold (2200K), single practical source per scene, hard shadow direction fixed; moonlight silver-blue (5600K) supplementary for exterior night; overcast diffuse (6500K) for exterior day, one-stop under key
style_lock_defaults.lighting_threshold: single beam of light through translucent silk or lattice window, dust motes visible in the beam
style_lock_defaults.lighting_superimposed: double exposure treatment reserved for post — never in IR
style_lock_defaults.color_grade: teal_and_amber with low overall saturation (target Sat -20 in DaVinci Resolve wheels), skin tones preserved with vector qualifier; ancient scenes shifted +5 warm, exterior scenes shifted +3 cool
style_lock_defaults.grain: 35mm Kodak 5219 500T grain plate, medium intensity, monochrome grain only (no chroma grain)
style_lock_defaults.world_transition_style: silk dissolve — a slow fabric-like wipe of one image over another, sync to sound of silk unfurling
style_lock_defaults.style_prefix_verbatim: Style: 8K IMAX. Photorealistic — no 3D render, no game engine, no game-cutscene aesthetic. Cinematography: telephoto compression from 85mm; painterly composed frames with strong negative space; silhouettes against contre-jour backlight. Lighting: Motivated natural or candle only — one hard source per scene, camera on shadow side; atmospheric mist reads in the beam. Color: teal and amber, low saturation, skin preserved. Camera: cine lens with 1/8 diffusion filter and 2mm gold streak. 180° shutter motion blur. Skin: pore-level realism — vellus hair, capillary flush, catch-lights in wet living eyes. Acting: micro-pauses before reactions; sleeve moves before hand; breath visible in cold. Physics: gravity respected — silk falls as silk, blade weight visible in wrist. Composition: golden ratio, negative space at 60%; every person moving from frame one. Continuity: identity holds across every cut. Technical: 24fps smooth motion, 8K detail, no jitter. Audio: environmental SFX only — wind, silk, breath, distant bell. No music.

sound_design_lock_defaults.ancient_signature: wind across paper doors, silk friction, distant temple bell every 90s, tea pouring, wooden floorboards under bare feet, breath in cold air
sound_design_lock_defaults.cross_world_marker: single stroke of a bronze bell decayed to 4-second reverb tail
sound_design_lock_defaults.theme_motif: guqin single-string pluck at moments of realization (post only — never in prompt)

@mes_bamboo_forest_dawn.text: morning mist between vertical bamboo trunks; wet stone path beneath; one shaft of amber light angling in from frame-left; a single fallen bamboo leaf rotating slowly on still water in a nearby stone basin

@mes_sword_chamber_night.text: black lacquer sword rack against a rice-paper wall; three swords in their sheaths; one candle in a bronze holder at frame-right, flame flickering at 5Hz; incense smoke rising in a thin vertical line and breaking into curl at ceiling; wooden floor with visible grain, one worn spot near the rack

@mes_mountain_cliff_dusk.text: sheer cliff face frame-left, mist boiling upward from unseen valley; a lone pine growing horizontally from the rock at frame-right; sky graded from teal (top) to amber (bottom); no wildlife; wind visible only in the pine needles

diegetic: bamboo trunks knocking hollowly in wind at ~0.5Hz
distant water drip on stone every 3-4s
single crow call once at second 8-10
wooden floor creak on weight shift
silk sleeve friction on sword hilt draw
one temple bell strike at second 12 with 4s decay tail

@preset_wuxia_grounded_v1.description: Wuxia (grounded martial). Inherits xianxia visual grammar but with faster ASL, more action weight, more handheld, less flying.
